_note: NSS's six cups per hole (bones GolfCourseNNholeK of the course model Fld_GolfCourseNN, k = 0..5: the cup bottoms), from the eden dump through tools/nss-registration.json. x, y = map fractions; world = the bone, NSS metres; surfaceY = the green surface over the cup (the top of HoleCover k, the plug that closes cup k while another is in play; 0.298-0.339 m above the bone; the game sets the flag pin at bone + 0.30), surfaceYd = it in yd above the datum (NSS y 0 = the WSR start's height); mesh = WSR KCL units at the surface; difficult = GolfFieldMgrParam HoleParams[hole-1].CupDifficulties[k] (the game leaves those out of some draws); ydFromWsrStart / ydFromTeeObj = the flat distance from the WSR start / the GlfTeeOBJ bone; nearestWsr = the nearest WSR pin spot (tools/wsr-pins.json, id s<slot>) and wsr = its id when it is within 0.3 yd (the same spot). cover.hub = the centre vertex of the cover's 20-triangle fan, dxzMm its offset from the bone (the collision's vertices sit on a 1/512 m grid). tees: Glf_RotateOBJ (where the online platform stands), GlfTeeOBJ (the local tee bone) and the WSR start (the app's tee for now). Generated by tools/nss-export.mjs.
